reason: As someone who has quit three services, A answers my real worries: no contract, skip or cancel any time, meal swaps, a call with the dietitian, and a concrete order deadline, while staying plain about the A1C limits. B has a "Real results" headline that feels like the usual health hype, an unfilled "[day/time]" placeholder, unsupported claims ("the food is good"), and leaves out cancel/swap details.
